title: 第15章 白长生第16章 神秘力量出手
lines: “今日，定叫你十死无生……”
下面在唱戏，唱得是一出富豪被灭门，遗孤复仇成功的故事。
狗血至极，这完全就是舔富人的。
富人做坏事被灭门，但跑掉的遗孤又能光耀门楣。
这酒楼里的人呢，纷纷叫好。
这个国家病了，病得不轻。
摇摇头，白羽继续吃菜喝酒。
“演的什么狗屁玩意儿。”
不适宜的声音响起，要不是白羽耳朵好，恐怕还听不见。
楼梯处，一魁梧汉子正在上楼梯，还一边骂道：“骄奢淫逸，皆是酒囊饭袋之徒！”
面露愤愤，他生气的来到楼梯旁桌子坐下，距离白羽也就几米远隔了一张桌子。
见状，白羽眯了眯眼小声道：“倒是也有明白人。”
那汉子也很豪横，落座后招呼小二上酒上菜，直接要了一大坛子。
不一会儿，东西上齐了，他先是吃了一口菜，然后喝上一大海碗的酒。
按江湖好汉的戏码，这是该说一声爽，但他却皱起眉头看向前方，目光直盯前边桌子上的酒坛。
“怎么跟闻见的不一样？”
嘀咕一句，他怒了，一拍桌子道：“小二！
给我滚过来！”
这一嗓子，下边儿戏都不唱了，所有人都将目光看向他。
招呼三楼的小二，此刻心里直呼倒了八辈子血霉，颤颤巍巍上前问道：“这…这位客官儿，您有……”
没等他话说完，那汉子一把揪住他衣领拉过来居高临下喷道：“你敢拿这些东西糊弄你爷爷，是以为爷的拳头不硬？”
他作势要打，小二连忙告饶道：“爷！
要打好歹也说清楚啊，咱也没做错什么呀。”
汉子也是个讲理人，他道：“好，挨揍也得被揍得明明白白。
我且问你，老子可有差钱？”
小二立马道：“不差，爷给的还有多的。”
汉子瞪眼道：“好啊，那为何上这些东西糊弄我？”
他指向白羽那边道：“我这酒闻起来就差远了，老子多付钱了凭什么还没他的酒好？！
死明白了吧，今儿这顿揍……”
白羽转过头，一脸懵逼。
合着问题在我这儿？
关键我是自带酒水呀。
小二一脸冤枉道：“爷！
那酒是那位客官自己带的，我给您上得就是咱这最好的呀。”
拳头停在半空，所有人目光转移看向白羽。
白羽道：“确实误会，这酒乃是我自己带来的。”
content_en:
"Today, you will definitely die without any chance of life..."
The opera was being sung below, and it was a story about a rich man being wiped out and an orphan succeeding in his revenge.
It's extremely bloody, and it's just for licking the rich.
A rich man does bad things and is exterminated, but the orphan who runs away can shine on the family lintel.
The people in the restaurant all applauded.
This country is sick, very sick.
Shaking his head, Bai Yu continued to eat and drink.
"What kind of bullshit are you acting?"
An inappropriate sound sounded. If Bai Yu hadn't had good ears, he might not have been able to hear it.
At the stairs, a burly man was going up the stairs, cursing: "Proud, extravagant and lewd people are all drunkards!"
With an indignant look on his face, he angrily came to the table next to the stairs and sat down, a table just a few meters away from Bai Yu.
Seeing this, Bai Yu narrowed his eyes and whispered: "There are some people who understand."
The man was also very arrogant. After sitting down, he asked the waiter to serve wine and food, and directly ordered a large jar.
After a while, everything was served. He first took a bite of the food, and then drank a large bowl of wine.
According to the drama of the Jianghu hero, this was a good thing to say, but instead he frowned and looked forward, staring directly at the wine jar on the table in front of him.
"Why is it different from what I heard?"
After muttering something, he became angry, slapped the table and said: "Waiter!
Get over here! "
With this voice, he stopped singing all the childish things, and everyone turned their eyes to him.
The waiter who greeted the waiter on the third floor felt like he was suffering from bad luck for eight lifetimes. He stepped forward tremblingly and asked: "This... guest officer, do you have..."
Before he could finish his words, the man grabbed his collar and pulled him over and shouted condescendingly: "You dare to fool your grandpa with these things, because you think his fists are not strong?"
He was about to fight, but the waiter quickly begged for mercy: "Master!
If you want to fight, let's make it clear. We didn't do anything wrong. "
The man was also a reasonable person, he said: "Okay, if you are beaten, you must be beaten clearly.
Let me ask you, do I have any money? "
The waiter immediately said: "It's not bad, I gave you more."
The man glared and said, "Okay, then why are you fooling me with these things?"
He pointed to Bai Yu and said: "My wine doesn't smell that good. I paid more, why is it not as good as his wine?!
You understand, I’m going to give you a beating today..."
Bai Yu turned his head, looking confused.
Is the problem with co-authorship here?
The key is that I bring my own drinks.
The waiter looked innocent and said: "Master!
That wine was brought by the guest officer himself, so what I serve to you is the best we have. "
The fist stopped in mid-air, and everyone turned to look at Bai Yu.
"Uh..."
Bai Yu said: "It is indeed a misunderstanding. I brought this wine myself."
title_en: Chapter 15 Bai Changsheng Chapter 16 The mysterious power takes action
